passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: This section is an analysis of the financial performance and of significant trends that may affect TotalEnergies’ future performance and it should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and the Notes thereto starting on page F-9. The Consolidated Financial Statements and the Notes thereto are prepared in accordance with IFRS as issued by the IASB and IFRS as adopted by the EU. The critical accounting estimates are disclosed in the paragraph "Major judgments and accounting estimates" of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements. This section contains forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties. For a list of important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed in the forward-looking statements, see “Cautionary Statement Concerning Forward-Looking Statements” starting on page i. For information on the invasion of Ukraine by Russia and the situation of the Company at March 27, 2026, refer to “Item 5. – 5.6 Situation of the Company in Russia at March 27, 2026” below. 5.1 Overview TotalEnergies’ results are affected by a variety of factors, including changes in crude oil and natural gas prices and refining and marketing margins, all generally expressed in dollars, as well as changes in exchange rates, particularly the value of the euro compared to the dollar. Higher crude oil and natural gas prices generally have a positive effect on the income of TotalEnergies because the Exploration & Production segment’s oil and gas business and the Integrated LNG and downstream gas business are positively impacted by the resulting increase in revenues. Lower crude oil and natural gas prices generally have a corresponding negative effect. The effect of changes in crude oil prices on the activities of TotalEnergies’ Refining & Chemicals and Marketing & Services segments (Downstream) depends upon the speed at which the prices of refined petroleum products adjust to reflect such changes. TotalEnergies’ results are also significantly affected by the costs of its activities, in particular those related to exploration and production, and by the outcome of its strategic decisions with respect to cost reduction efforts. In addition, TotalEnergies’ results are affected by general economic and political conditions and changes in governmental laws and regulations, as well as by the impact of decisions by OPEC+ on production levels. For more information, refer to “Item 3. – 3.1 Risk factors”. In 2025, TotalEnergies reported IFRS net income of $13.1 billion, adjusted net income 1 of $15.6 billion, cash flow from operating activities of $27.3 billion and cash flow from operations excluding working capital (CFFO) 1 of $27.8 billion in an environment marked by a decline of 15% in oil prices. Return on average capital employed (ROACE) 1 stood at 12.6%, the best among the majors for the fourth consecutive year. TotalEnergies continued to implement its balanced, disciplined growth strategy by investing $17.1 billion in 2025, including 37% for new Oil & Gas projects and around $3.5 billion in low ‑ carbon energies, of which nearly $3 billion in electricity. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow of twenty-seven billion dollars dwarfs the seven point seven billion dollars of buybacks, a coverage multiple above three times, so distributions are comfortably funded from internally generated cash rather than borrowing.

Cash of twenty-six billion dollars against a revenue base of two hundred billion dollars gives substantial liquidity cushion, and management reports return on average capital employed of twelve point six percent, described as best among the majors for a fourth consecutive year.

key_risks.text: Results are directly levered to crude oil and gas prices, refining and marketing margins and the euro-dollar rate; management notes a fifteen percent oil price decline in the period, and OPEC+ production decisions and regulatory change are cited as material swing factors.

The current ratio sits below one and below the prior year and the sector median, indicating working capital liabilities exceed current assets; this is typical for a trading-heavy energy major but leaves limited buffer if margins compress.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: No borrowing tags were reported at the balance-sheet date, so gross and net leverage, interest coverage and free-cash-flow-to-debt cannot be computed; the debt note must be reviewed to confirm whether funded debt is genuinely nil or merely untagged.

Lease liabilities of roughly ten billion dollars sit outside the debt definition, and capital investment of seventeen billion dollars plus buybacks absorb most operating cash flow, so headroom depends on sustained commodity prices rather than on balance-sheet gearing.

overall_credit_view.text: This is a large, cash-generative integrated energy issuer whose operating cash flow covers shareholder returns several times over; absent reported borrowings, credit quality rests on commodity price resilience and disciplined capital allocation rather than on leverage metrics.

Our judgement is a solid investment-grade profile, but the missing debt, interest expense and capital expenditure tags are material: until the debt note is confirmed, leverage and coverage comparisons against the sector median remain unknown and the indicative risk profile stays unassigned.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流達二百七十億美元，遠超七十七億美元的股份回購，覆蓋倍數高於三倍，因此分派可由內部產生的現金而非借貸從容支付。
現金達二百六十億美元，相對二千億美元的營收基礎，提供充裕的流動性緩衝；管理層報告平均已運用資本回報率為百分之十二點六，並稱之為連續第四年為同業之冠。

key_risks.text: 業績直接受原油及天然氣價格、煉油與營銷利潤率及歐元兌美元匯率所槓桿影響；管理層指出期內油價下跌百分之十五，並將OPEC+的產量決定及監管變動列為重大波動因素。
流動比率低於一，且低於上年及行業中位數，顯示營運資金負債超過流動資產；此對以貿易為主的大型能源企業而言屬典型情況，但若利潤率受壓，緩衝空間有限。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 於資產負債表日並無報告任何借款標籤，因此無法計算總槓桿及淨槓桿、利息覆蓋率及自由現金流對債務比率；必須審閱債務附註，以確認有資金支持的債務是否確實為零，抑或僅屬未標籤。
約一百億美元的租賃負債不在債務定義之內，而一百七十億美元的資本投資加上股份回購已吸收大部分營運現金流，因此餘裕取決於商品價格能否持續，而非取決於資產負債表槓桿。

overall_credit_view.text: 此為大型、具現金生成能力的綜合能源發行人，其營運現金流對股東回報的覆蓋達數倍；在並無報告借款的情況下，信貸質素取決於商品價格的韌性及資本配置的紀律，而非槓桿指標。
我們的判斷為穩健的投資級別狀況，但缺失的債務、利息開支及資本開支標籤屬重大事項：在債務附註獲確認之前，與行業中位數的槓桿及覆蓋比較仍屬未知，指示性風險狀況維持不予評定。
